notes: «أيوب بن نوح وغيره» is one level of two co-transmitters: «غيره» is an unnamed «others» and is not a separate level
«سأل رجل أبا عبد الله» names an asker who is only in the scene («وأنا أسمع» is Abu al-Yasa's own presence), so he is not a link
The Imam answers inside Abu al-Yasa's account, so he is the last link (narrated encounter); the honorific «(ع)» is left out

fixes.reason: RWY reads «غيره» as a separate level after «أيوب بن نوح»; the text joins it to أيوب with «و» in one level, as an unnamed co-transmitter
